newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paribas raises rating on Accor to buy.
newsitem.headline: Paribas raises rating on Accor to buy.

text.p: Paribas Capital Markets raised its rating on French hotel group Accor for the second time in as many weeks, boosting it to buy from neutral, market sources said on Thursday.

Last week Paribas raised its rating on Accor to neutral from buy, citing currency movements favourable to the group, which has a U.S. subsidiary Motel 6, and the appointment of Jean-Marc Espalioux as the new chairman.
Shares in Accor were up 3.82 percent at 680 francs at 1530 GMT. The CAC-40 index was up 0.87 percent at the same time.
"I've been a seller on the stock for the best part of the last three and a half years," said Paribas analyst Nigel Reed, who confirmed that he had raised his rating on Accor's stock to buy.
He said the share had underperformed the French bourse, while indicators generally augured well for the company.

Reed said he expected a fourth-quarter hotel occupancy rates to show an increase after a strong third quarter. The French economy is expected to grow 2.3 percent next year, which would be helpful for the company.
The franc's recent weakness should draw tourism revenue and will also translate into higher earnings at Accor's Motel 6 unit.
The stock closed up 5.5 percent at 691 francs.
